scope.supports: General rational list normalization idempotence and positive-weight-ray classification at literal sum/scalar hypotheses; exact native witnesses and a phase-forgetting counterexample.
scope.does_not_support: Classification of complex amplitude rays, derivation or uniqueness of Born pairing, a formal probability-subtype operad, or publication/erratum completion.
scope.narrowest_claim: The quotient is by positive scaling of weight vectors, with a unique normalized representative; equal weights can still come from different amplitude rays.
scope.next_test: Batch review must check the literal weight/amplitude distinction and every retained proof/native receipt.
